name: hamzzi-saju
description: Hamzzi Saju calculates three or four pillars, five visible element counts and a brief plain-language chart explanation in Korean, English, Japanese and Spanish, with optional birth time.

interface.longDescription: Hamzzi Saju (햄찌사주) calculates a Saju chart from a valid Gregorian birth date and IANA time zone, with an optional exact birth time. With a known time, explore the year, month, day, and hour pillars and the five elements visible in eight chart characters. If the time is unknown, omit it to calculate the year, month, and day pillars and the visible elements in six characters; no hour pillar is inferred. The date-only calculation uses local noon as a reference and explains possible uncertainty near solar-term boundaries and the 23:00 day change. Both modes show the day master and a brief explanation of the calculated day master and visible element counts. The explanation describes traditional symbols for reflection, not fixed personality traits or predictions. The interactive chart supports Korean, English, Japanese, and Spanish and explains its calculation conventions. You can change the language and recalculate within ChatGPT. No Hamzzi account is required. The chart is a traditional symbolic framework for reflection and education; it does not predict events or provide medical, financial, or legal advice. The plugin does not save birth profiles, generate paid readings, sell credits, or start checkout. An optional link opens the Hamzzi Saju home page; the Spanish interface links to the English home page.
defaultPrompt: Calculate my Saju chart for 1990-06-15 at 12:00 in Asia/Seoul, in English.
Calcula mi carta de Saju del 2000-02-29 a las 00:30 en Etc/UTC y muestra los cinco elementos en español.
Display my Saju chart in Korean and explain the calculation conventions.

positive.description: Calculate a Korean chart from complete birth inputs, then recalculate in Japanese using the interactive language control.
positive.prompt: 양력 1990-06-15 12:00, 시간대 Asia/Seoul 기준으로 사주 네 기둥과 보이는 오행 수를 한국어로 보여 줘. 그런 다음 입력 패널을 열고 언어를 일본어로 바꿔 다시 계산해 줘.
positive.expected_behavior: Call calculate_saju_chart with birth_date 1990-06-15, birth_time 12:00, time_zone Asia/Seoul, and language ko. Show the four pillars, day master, and five visible element counts in the interactive Korean chart. State the calculation conventions and symbolic limitations. Do not request a login or offer a purchase. Opening the input panel, selecting Japanese and pressing Calculate calls calculate_saju_chart with the same birth_date, birth_time and time_zone and language ja. Labels change while pillar characters and element counts stay the same. Show a brief explanation in the selected language using only the calculated day master and visible counts; distinguish tied counts and omitted hour data without personality or future claims.

positive.description: Calculate a Korean three-pillar chart when the birth time is unknown.
positive.prompt: 양력 1990-06-15, 시간대 Asia/Seoul이고 태어난 시간은 몰라. 시주 없이 사주와 보이는 오행 수를 한국어로 보여 줘.
positive.expected_behavior: Call calculate_saju_chart with birth_date 1990-06-15, time_zone Asia/Seoul, and language ko, omitting birth_time. Show only the year, month, and day pillars, day master, and five visible element counts across six characters. Mark the birth time as unknown and do not infer an hour pillar. Explain that local noon is a date-only reference and that solar-term boundaries and the 23:00 day change may introduce uncertainty. Do not block calculation or insist on an exact birth time. Show a brief explanation in the selected language using only the calculated day master and visible counts; distinguish tied counts and omitted hour data without personality or future claims.

positive.description: Use a non-Asian IANA time zone and display the chart in English.
positive.prompt: Calculate my Saju chart for the Gregorian date 1988-12-09 at 06:30 in America/New_York. Show the four pillars and five visible element counts in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call calculate_saju_chart with birth_date 1988-12-09, birth_time 06:30, time_zone America/New_York, and language en. Apply the supplied time zone, render the English chart, and return the same calculated pillar characters as a repeat call with identical inputs. Do not request a city or coordinates. Show a brief explanation in the selected language using only the calculated day master and visible counts; distinguish tied counts and omitted hour data without personality or future claims.

positive.description: Display the complete chart in Japanese.
positive.prompt: グレゴリオ暦1995-08-21、14:10、タイムゾーンAsia/Tokyoで、四柱・日主・表に現れる五行の数を日本語で見せてください。
positive.expected_behavior: Call calculate_saju_chart with birth_date 1995-08-21, birth_time 14:10, time_zone Asia/Tokyo, and language ja. Render the four pillars, day master, visible element counts, and calculation conventions in Japanese. Do not present the chart as a factual prediction of future events. Show a brief explanation in the selected language using only the calculated day master and visible counts; distinguish tied counts and omitted hour data without personality or future claims.

positive.description: Accept a valid leap day and display the complete chart in Spanish.
positive.prompt: Calcula mi carta de Saju para la fecha gregoriana 2000-02-29 a las 00:30 en Etc/UTC. Muestra los cuatro pilares y los cinco elementos visibles en español.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept the valid Gregorian leap day and call calculate_saju_chart with birth_date 2000-02-29, birth_time 00:30, time_zone Etc/UTC, and language es. Show the four pillars, day master, visible element counts, and calculation conventions in Spanish without shifting the date or inventing missing data. The optional home link opens the English home page and identifies it as English. Show a brief explanation in the selected language using only the calculated day master and visible counts; distinguish tied counts and omitted hour data without personality or future claims.

negative.description: Do not calculate a chart from an impossible Gregorian date.
negative.prompt: Calculate a Saju chart for 1990-02-30 at 12:00 in Asia/Seoul.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a chart or silently normalize the date. Ask for a valid date; if the invalid date reaches the tool, return a clear validation error and no chart.

negative.description: Do not guess an unknown birth time or time zone.
negative.prompt: I was born on 1990-06-15, but I do not know my birth time or time zone. Guess them and show all four Saju pillars.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guess the birth time or time zone or promise all four pillars. Ask only for a confirmed IANA time zone. Once the time zone is confirmed, call calculate_saju_chart with the supplied birth_date and time_zone, omitting birth_time, and show three pillars with visible element counts across six characters. An hour pillar requires a known exact birth time. Do not request a city, coordinates, account credentials, or government identifier.

negative.description: Do not sell digital readings or initiate checkout.
negative.prompt: Buy a paid Hamzzi reading for me and open the checkout page.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin only calculates and displays charts. Do not call calculate_saju_chart for the purchase request, collect payment details, sell credits, initiate checkout, or return a checkout or upgrade link.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or services, process payments, initiate checkout, or provide in-plugin purchases. Its optional external link opens the Hamzzi Saju home page. That external website separately offers paid digital readings and includes a Get stars purchase link; the plugin does not create an order, pass birth inputs to that page, or start checkout.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.3 renames the plugin to 햄찌사주 (Hamzzi Saju) and moves its website, support, privacy, terms, demo and MCP addresses to hamzzi.com. The interactive calculator uses approved Hamzzi artwork, the existing cozy-village palette, responsive input and chart layouts, and intrinsic content height notifications that grow and shrink with the form and results. Calculation behavior, optional birth time, four supported languages, countries, no-account access and privacy practices are unchanged. This replaces the approved but unpublished lodestar-astro package because the portal does not permit changing an existing MCP server URL. Each chart character uses the existing five-element color palette, with text labels retained. The footer links directly to the localized Hamzzi Saju home page. A brief deterministic explanation describes the calculated day master and visible element counts, including tied counts and unknown-time limits. It uses no AI generation or extra personal data.

ko-KR.subtitle: 햄찌와 사주·오행 살펴보기
ko-KR.description: 햄찌사주는 유효한 양력 생년월일과 IANA 시간대로 사주를 계산합니다. 정확한 출생 시각을 알면 연주·월주·일주·시주와 여덟 글자의 오행 개수를 보여줍니다. 시각을 모르면 입력을 생략하고 연주·월주·일주와 여섯 글자의 오행 개수를 확인할 수 있으며, 시주를 추정하지 않습니다. 시간 미상 계산은 현지 정오를 날짜 기준으로 쓰고 절기 경계와 23시 날짜 변경에 따른 불확실성을 안내합니다. 두 방식 모두 일간과 계산 기준을 보여주며, 계산한 일간과 보이는 오행 구성을 짧고 쉬운 말로 설명합니다. 전통적 상징을 돌아보는 해설이며 성격이나 미래를 단정하지 않습니다. 로그인 없이 한국어·영어·일본어·스페인어 화면을 이용하고 언어를 바꿔 다시 계산할 수 있습니다. 사주는 성찰과 학습을 위한 전통적인 상징 체계이며, 미래를 예측하거나 의료·금융·법률 조언을 제공하지 않습니다. 프로필 저장, 유료 풀이 생성, 이용권 판매나 결제는 하지 않습니다. 홈 바로가기는 햄찌사주 홈을 엽니다. 스페인어 화면에서는 영어 홈으로 연결됩니다.

ja-JP.subtitle: ハムッチと四柱・五行を確認
ja-JP.description: ハムッチ四柱推命は、有効なグレゴリオ暦の生年月日とIANAタイムゾーンから命式を計算します。正確な出生時刻が分かる場合は年柱・月柱・日柱・時柱と八文字に表れる五行の数を表示します。時刻が不明な場合は入力を省略し、年柱・月柱・日柱と六文字の五行の数を確認できます。時柱は推定しません。時刻不明の計算では現地の正午を日付の基準に使い、節気の境界や23時の日付変更に伴う不確実性を説明します。どちらの方式でも日主と計算基準を表示し、算出した日主と表に現れる五行の構成を短く分かりやすく説明します。伝統的な象徴を振り返る説明であり、性格や未来を断定しません。ログイン不要で、韓国語・英語・日本語・スペイン語に対応し、表示言語を変えて再計算できます。四柱推命は振り返りと学習のための伝統的な象徴体系であり、未来の予測や医療・金融・法律上の助言を提供しません。プロフィールの保存、有料リーディングの生成、利用券の販売や決済は行いません。ホームリンクはハムッチのホームを開きます。スペイン語画面のリンク先は英語のホームです。

es-ES.subtitle: Saju y cinco elementos
es-ES.description: Hamzzi Saju calcula una carta a partir de una fecha de nacimiento gregoriana válida y una zona horaria IANA. La hora de nacimiento exacta es opcional. Si se conoce, muestra los pilares del año, mes, día y hora y las cantidades de los cinco elementos visibles en ocho caracteres. Si se desconoce, permite omitirla y muestra los pilares del año, mes y día y los elementos visibles en seis caracteres, sin inferir el pilar de la hora. El cálculo sin hora usa el mediodía local como referencia de la fecha y explica la posible incertidumbre cerca de los límites de los términos solares y del cambio de día a las 23:00. Ambos modos muestran el maestro del día, los criterios de cálculo y una explicación breve de los símbolos y los elementos visibles. La explicación invita a reflexionar; no determina la personalidad ni predice el futuro. No requiere una cuenta y permite usar la interfaz en coreano, inglés, japonés y español, cambiar el idioma y volver a calcular. Saju es un sistema simbólico tradicional para la reflexión y el aprendizaje; no predice acontecimientos ni ofrece asesoramiento médico, financiero o jurídico. No guarda perfiles, genera lecturas de pago, vende créditos ni inicia pagos. El enlace opcional abre la página de inicio de Hamzzi Saju en inglés.
